newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Treasury has 1.263 bln real January deficit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Treasury has 1.263 bln real January deficit.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury posted a 1.263 billion real deficit in January, compared with a shortfall of 1.445 billion reais in the same month a year ago, the Treasury said.
In a statement, the Treasury said its primary result, which does not include interest payments, was a 304 million real deficit, against a deficit of 632 million reais in January 1996.

The Treasury said its nominal result, which is the difference between fiscal receipts and total expenditure, was a 2.628 billion real shortfall in January, compared with a deficit of 2.765 billion reais in January last year.
Total receipts were 8.334 billion reais versus 7.505 billion reais in January 1996 and total expenditure was 8.639 billion reais versus 8.136 billion reais in January a year ago.
